Mount Kilimanjaro

Mount Kilimanjaro is a dormant volcano in Tanzania. It is the highest mountain in Africa, rising about 5,895 metres above sea level.

The mountain lies near the border with Kenya, and on clear days it can be seen from Amboseli National Park in Kenya.

Kilimanjaro has three volcanic cones: Kibo, Mawenzi and Shira. Kibo is the highest and its summit is called Uhuru Peak.
